findings: Both prior OpticalZoom.outputSizes overloads could mark the entire fixed-camera route failed during capability enumeration; common() did the same for absent intersections and returned logical-only sizes. A query is not proof that an actual output session failed.
The camera readiness host was registered only after optional lens-row geometry/overlap checks. When the row cannot render, recovery waits for a host that was never registered.
fixes: Map physical output queries to a nonfatal, exact size intersection. Unsupported optional formats return an empty size list, not unverified logical sizes. Actual fixed session validation and failure handling remain unchanged.
Register the live preview host at UI attach, before optional lens-row layout checks. Existing shown/window-focus, foreground, recording and still-capture guards remain.
unchanged: all 164 application method payloads, assets, native modifications and other-app patches
main-wide 1x, macro, 3x/5x identity and output binding
no distance-driven lens switching; normal AF
beauty, HEIF, requested resolution, saved-image correction and save-speed work
camera state/retry limits and active-session checks
Entire prior v1.7.7 chroma mitigation runtime, default-on option, save pipeline and other-app payloads retained; based on published d0a04a4a/3e5f885f artifacts, not unpublished preview candidate.
limits: Host Camera2 doubles are not Android ART or Samsung camera HAL execution.
No device logs were available; the defects were confirmed in code, not demonstrated to be the only cause of the submitted screenshot.
No claim that black preview is fully resolved on Galaxy or that launch time improved by a measured amount.
